headline: No US-Iran Talks Planned, Hormuz Remains Closed
summary: US President Donald Trump said no talks with Iran were taking place or scheduled, while insisting the Strait of Hormuz was open. The statement came amid the ongoing conflict.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint through which a large share of global seaborne oil passes. Diplomatic developments there directly affect crude supply and prices.
why_moved: With no talks planned and the strait described as closed, uncertainty over Gulf oil flows persists.
